list_detail.name: List/Detail App

data_source.description: Data source name or inline table (e.g., 'Inventory' or '[{Title:"Item 1"}]')

display_field.description: Primary field to show in gallery items

subtitle_field.description: Secondary field for gallery item subtitles

fields.description: Fields to display in detail and form screens

inspection.name: Inspection/Checklist App
inspection.description: Sequential checklist with step tracking and summary. Best for: inspections, audits, onboarding checklists.

directory.name: Directory/Profile App
directory.description: People gallery with search and profile detail view. Best for: employee directories, team rosters, expert finders.

detail_fields.description: Fields to show on profile screen

tracker.name: Milestone Tracker App
tracker.description: Dashboard with task list, status indicators, and edit form. Best for: project tracking, milestones, kanban.
